Inside, rolled tight, a note in a child's careful hand: 'If found, please tell my father the gulls reached the island. He said they wouldn't. — Moira, 1912.' Elias sat down on a salt-whitened beam and read it twice. Somewhere a promise had been kept for over a century, waiting for a witness. He put the note in his coat, deciding the lighthouse could tell the story after all.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像退潮后的滩涂，安静得能听见红绿灯变换的咔嗒声。环卫车的灯光扫过空荡的街口，早点铺的第一缕蒸汽爬上卷帘门。写字楼里还亮着几扇固执的窗，像不肯睡去的眼睛。出租车缓缓驶过高架，载着一整夜的疲惫。天色最深的时候，其实离黎明最近——这座城市在打盹，却没有真正入睡。", "w03": "- Imagine standing dominoes in a line: you only push the first one, and every domino knows its one job is to knock the next.\n- To solve a big problem, you do one small piece yourself, then hand the rest to a smaller copy of you, like passing chores down a staircase.\n- You keep going until you hit the easiest possible case — the bottom domino — and then everything falls into place, all the way back up."}
